newsitem.title: HONG KONG: RESEARCH ALERT-Nomura upgrades Shun Tak to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Nomura upgrades Shun Tak to hold.

text.p: Nomura Research Institute said it upgraded Shun Tak Holdings Ltd to hold from sell and raised its earnings estimates for the company through 1998.

In a report dated October 9, Nomura said it raised its 1996 net profit forecast to HK$639 million from a previous forecast of HK$587 million, its 1997 forecast to HK$702 million from HK$651 million, and its 1998 forecast to HK$985 million from HK$846 million.
"A recovery of the company's jetfoil operations is finally in sight," Nomura said. It revised its jetfoil traffic forecast for 1996 to growth of 2.5 percent from a two percent drop.
Nomura said it expects jetfoil profit contributions to recover with 12 percent growth in 1997 and 16 percent in 1998.

"The momentum of earnings is currently slow despite the raised earnings estimates, but is likely to accelerate from FY98 onwards thanks to property sales at Belcher Gardens and at the Cheung Sha Wan shipyard project in Hong Kong," Nomura said.

It said it expects little downside to Shun Tak shares below HK$5.00 but said "share price outperformance is not likely until a recovery in the jetfoil operations becomes more solid and Belcher Gardens sales come closer to reality".
Shun Tak shares closed at HK$5.25 on Wednesday.
